# Textarea — Cobalt source template

<!-- Generated by tools/content.mjs from MDX and source; do not edit. -->

A naked multi-line text-input control built on Cobalt `Textarea`. For labels, descriptions, hints, and character counters, compose with `FormField` externally.

## Copy and adapt

This is editable source, not an installable library. Never install `@openpencil/cobalt-extensions` or import that package name. Official `@talkdesk/*` dependencies are separate.

Before reuse, read the complete implementation, types, styles and local imports listed below. Use the HTML Skill lookup command with `--id extensions.textarea --read-source` to read the source closure. Copy the templates into `src/components/cobalt-extensions/`, then import using a relative path to that project-local directory and adapt the implementation there.

Workspace creation copies the full tree. For a standalone/existing app, run the bundled `cobalt-project.mjs copy-source --out <project>`; it copies source without installing dependencies or replacing existing files. Read the copied `dependencies.json` and add only the required official dependencies to the target app.

Search terms: Textarea, textarea, Cobalt Extensions, reusable component.

Exports: `Textarea`, `TextareaProps`, `TextareaSize`, `TextareaVariation`.
